WITH film_category_films AS (
  SELECT fc.film_id, f.rating
  FROM film_category fc
  JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id
),
counts_by_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM film_category_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) AS total
  FROM counts_by_rating
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cbr.rating,
    cbr.count,
    CAST(cbr.count AS FLOAT) / tc.total AS share
  FROM counts_by_rating cbr
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  s.rating,
  s.count,
  s.share,
  s.share - av.avg_share AS deviation
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN average_share av
ORDER BY s.rating
